description: This file defines a D3-based visualization component for rendering partition and icicle charts, including data processing, tooltip handling, and zoom interactions.

classes.name: PartitionDataNode
classes.description: Interface representing a node of partition data with optional children.

classes.name: PartitionNode
classes.description: Extends HierarchyNode with additional properties for visualization, such as position, size, color, and parent reference.

classes.name: IcicleProps
classes.description: Interface defining properties for the Icicle visualization component, including data, dimensions, color scheme, formatting options, and interaction flags.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Calculates layout positions (x, y, dx, dy) for each node in the hierarchy and returns a flat array of nodes.

methods.name: getAncestors
methods.description: Returns an array of ancestor nodes for a given node, starting from the root.

methods.name: Icicle
methods.description: Main function that renders the icicle chart within a given HTML element based on provided properties, handling layout, interaction, and tooltip display.
